help.title: eFil Help
help.subtitle: Short guide to application features
help.gettingStarted1: Register with your email and password
help.gettingStarted2: After login, your first inventory is created automatically
help.gettingStarted3: Click Add new filament in the menu
help.gettingStarted4: Fill in basic info (material, colour, weight)
help.gettingStarted5: The filament appears in the stock overview
help.navIntro: The app uses a three-step filter for easy browsing:
help.navFilterTip: You can combine filters or reset with Clear filters button
help.navPriceDesc: On MAT, BAR and VÝR cards the average price per kilogram (CZK/kg) is shown. Only filaments with a price are included; original spool weight is used. Groups show the x̄ (average) symbol, individual filaments show the value in CZK/kg.
help.navAddWizardDesc: On each screen (MAT, BAR, VÝR) there is a + after the cards. Click to open the new filament form:
help.navAddBar: BAR – material is pre-filled (if you filtered by it)
help.navAddVyr: VÝR – material and colour are pre-filled from current filters
help.consumeExact2: Enter the consumed weight in grams
help.consumeExact3: Optionally add a note (e.g. project name)
help.consumeWeigh3: The app automatically subtracts spool tare
help.consumeTip: For accurate weighing, set the spool type when adding the filament
help.statsIntro: In the menu choose Statistics. You will see the overview of your currently selected inventory (with multiple inventories, the one you have selected applies).
help.statsList1: Total in stock – sum of remaining weight of all filaments (g)
help.statsList2: Estimated value – estimate in CZK from price and remaining weight
help.statsList3: Spool count – number of filaments in the inventory
help.statsList4: Consumption (30 days) – total consumption in the last 30 days (kg)
help.statsMaterialDesc: Pie chart shows the share of remaining weight by material (PLA, PETG, etc.).
help.statsHistoryDesc: Bar chart shows consumption by day (last 30 days). Below is a table of individual consumption records with edit or delete options.
help.manufacturersIntro: When adding or editing a filament you can pick a manufacturer from the list or enter a new one.
help.manufacturers1: From list – in the Manufacturer field choose an existing one (ordered: most used in inventory, then alphabetically)
help.manufacturers2: New manufacturer – click + next to the field and enter the name; the new manufacturer is created as your private one and will be available in other forms
help.manufacturers3: For spool types you can assign multiple manufacturers to one type (multiselect)
help.manufacturersTip: Public manufacturers are shared; you only see your own private ones. You can only delete a manufacturer that is not used by any filament or spool type.
help.spools1: When adding a filament, select the spool type from the list
help.spools2: If your type is not in the list, click + – the new type field expands, other form fields (material, colour, manufacturer…) are kept
help.spools3: Colour and material of the spool type are required; when expanding they are pre-filled from the filament’s colour and material
help.spools4: Enter other details (diameter, width). Enter weight of empty spool only when you have it empty
help.spools5: When saving the filament, the filament manufacturer is automatically applied to the new spool type too
help.spools6: The spool type is saved and will be available for other filaments
help.sharing4: Colleague clicks I have an invite code on the login page
help.sharing5: After entering the code they get access to your inventory
help.sharingPermissionTip: To change permissions use menu → User management
help.usersAdd3: If the user exists, they are added to the inventory
help.usersAdd4: If not, a new account is created and they receive an email
help.shortcutsIntro: Most used operations can be triggered from the keyboard:
help.accessibilityIntro: The eFil application aims for accessibility in line with web content accessibility requirements (WCAG 2.1) at level AA, within the scope allowed by the technologies used.
help.accessibilityList1: We use semantic HTML, form labels and appropriate contrast.
help.accessibilityList2: Keyboard shortcuts are listed in the Keyboard shortcuts section above and in this statement.
help.accessibilityList3: Responsive layout and browser zoom support.
help.accountSectionIntro: In the My account section you can:
help.tips1: Use the Location field for easy finding (e.g. "Shelf A")
help.tips2: You can change the filament number freely to match your system
help.tips3: Filaments with zero weight are hidden automatically
help.tips4: Browser Back/Forward buttons work for in-app navigation
help.tips5: You can add a new filament from any wizard screen via + (material and colour are pre-filled from filters)
help.tips6: Demo account is for viewing only; create your own for full access
